Chapter 6993: Fantian Dynasty

Chapter 6993: Fantian Dynasty

“You’re in the wrong here, just leave the mud alone instead of trying to use it to build. It was meant never to be put on walls in the first place.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“You!” Mo Xiangsheng was furious: “Truly an unteachable brat.”

“Don’t have to teach me, go find your celestial source.” Li Qiye smiled.

“And you?” He paused for a moment.

“I’ll take a look at this world.” Li Qiye said.

“You need to follow me, or you will die.” He said.

“Everyone dies eventually, sooner for mortals.” Li Qiye said.

“You really this open-minded?” He stared strangely at Li Qiye.

“Yes, goodbye then.” Li Qiye smiled and walked away.

“Brat, this is not a joke. Immortals are everywhere now and can accidentally destroy massive areas. You will die without realizing it, follow me and live longer.” He said.

“Only time will tell.” Li Qiye shook his head.

“Shit, this is the first time I’ve met such a stubborn little bastard. I’m leaving then.” He was still an overlord and left after seeing Li Qiye’s insistence.

***

Li Qiye traveled through Dusk Realm, able to see its entirety unlike the others.

Although he appeared to be walking, others couldn’t spot him at all due to his incredible speed. He saw trillions of living beings. However, this number was still small compared to the realm’s size.

In just a short time, immortals and overlords appeared everywhere to the inhabitants’ dismay. This was a disaster; those who could run immediately headed for the wilderness.

Kingdoms and sects evacuated with haste and chaos before Li Qiye’s eyes.

“That’s why there shouldn’t be immortals.” Li Qiye shook his head.

Mortals and cultivators, in their ignorance, wondered about how great it would be for immortals to descend to their world. They were too optimistic and thought immortals would benefit their worlds, removing illness and granting resources.

However, why would immortals bother to do so? Dusk Realm’s inhabitants learned this lesson the hard way.

Eventually, Li Qiye arrived at a kingdom’s ancestral ground - Fantian Dynasty. This was the strongest dynasty in Dusk Realm. Its progenitor rarely appeared after creating it.

This ancestral ground was highly guarded despite an evacuation order. This was because their progenitor was still under isolated cultivation.

Ancient palaces and lofty halls stood tall, blessed by billowing essences. However, it fell into a state of turmoil during the evacuation. Cultivators constantly moved in and out.

Therefore, few paid attention to a mortal such as Li Qiye. They assumed he was lost in the panic.

He took a look at the deepest area of the ancestral ground and smiled: “Here it is, quite insightful.”

Finally, a guard noticed Li Qiye: “Leave right now, this is not the place for you to be.”

He ignored them, prompting more to summon their treasures and weapons.

“Kill him!” They immediately attacked due to the current crisis.

Alas, nothing happened to him. They realized he was a mighty foe and blew their horns. Massive figures answered the call instantly.
